reasons: § 12.4 imposes a 24-month post-term, worldwide, undefined-scope non-compete on Customer with no carve-outs — squarely walk-away territory under NONCOMPETE and failing the fallback on duration, scope and carve-outs, so 'deviation' is the correct status.

The redline deletes p0050 in full, which is the minimal edit that reaches the preferred position; § 12.3 already affirmatively preserves Customer's freedom to develop, acquire and sell competing products, so nothing needs to be substituted.
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains after the edit.

The comment is accurate (correctly notes the direct contradiction with § 12.3), on-tone, uses the required prefix and first person plural, and offers the narrowed fallback (named product, term only, carve-outs) as a settlement path without lecturing.
